## Selected projects

- [RSI panorama](https://zhangmin.name/panoramas/recursive-self-improvement/): Chinese interactive field guide to recursive self-improvement, with six conceptual layers, twelve research references, four step-by-step instructional cases, and an illustrative feedback simulator.

- [Frontier Benchmarks](https://github.com/zhangmin510/frontier-benchmarks): Chinese benchmark explorer covering 23 evaluations of frontier OpenAI and Anthropic models.
- [2×2 Cube Lab](https://zhangmin.name/cube-guide/): interactive Chinese tutorial with diagrams, formula playback, a draggable 3D cube, quizzes, and local progress tracking.
- [MeetingCopter](https://github.com/zhangmin510/MeetingCopter): macOS meeting reminder MVP built with Swift 6.
- [obsidian-podium](https://github.com/zhangmin510/obsidian-podium): Obsidian plugin that presents existing Markdown notes as fullscreen slides with adaptive pagination and annotation tools.
